messages.content:
Risk: Confidential data in prompt (ID: atlas-confidential-data-in-prompt)
Description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output. Additionally, end users' confidential information might be unintentionally collected and stored.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Axis: data protection requirement (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/DataProtectionRequirement)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/BorrowerDataProtectionRequirement: borrower data protection requirement

Axis: Warning Message (https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00002011)
Roles: object, instrument
Siblings:
  - https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00002013: Notification Message
  - https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00002012: Email Message
